messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] classification of high dimensional sparse data

I would start with having a look at the reverse dependencies of the Matrix package:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Matrix/index.html

Also googling  "r sparse clustering" seems to return many relevant hits.
Particularly, this one that stresses the sparsity of the feature matrix, and not the similarity graph.

Is anything in particular you need?
